$comment: Pre-registered parameters. Changing anything here after the full run starts invalidates the pre-registration; log every change in METHODOLOGY.md §11.

generation.$comment: claude-sonnet-5-5 rejects thinking {type:'disabled'} and non-default sampling params (400). 'between_tools' is the documented thinking-off setting (valid at effort high or below); temperature is left at the API default. Amended 2026-10-11 before any full-run generation (METHODOLOGY.md §11).

once_ui.package_version_field: 2.0.0 (version bump happens at release; this tree is the 2.1 release candidate)

once_ui_full_run.$comment: The pilot used the RC tree pinned in sources.once_ui. The full run installs the published package; setup.mjs --once-version records the tarball sha256 in work/context-manifest.json and the results folder.

rater.$comment: One call per blinded packet (runner/rate-api.mjs). The pre-registered 'temperature 0' is rejected by claude-sonnet-5-5 (non-default sampling parameters return 400); default sampling is used instead (METHODOLOGY.md §11).

pricing_usd_per_mtok.source: Anthropic list prices as of 2026-10-11 (claude-api reference); cache write assumed at 1.25x input
pricing_usd_per_mtok.$comment: Used only for the secondary cache-aware cost metric (METHODOLOGY.md §4.1a).
